mapper.insert: insert into voya_ai_trip_share (trip_id, user_id, share_code, share_token, expire_time, status, create_time) values (#{tripId}, #{userId}, #{shareCode}, #{shareToken}, #{expireTime}, '0', now())
mapper.select: select id, trip_id as tripId, share_code as shareCode, share_token as shareToken, expire_time as expireTime, status, create_time as createTime from voya_ai_trip_share where trip_id = #{tripId} and status = '0' and expire_time > now()

select id, trip_id as tripId, share_code as shareCode, share_token as shareToken, expire_time as expireTime, status, create_time as createTime from voya_ai_trip_share where share_code = #{shareCode} and status = '0'
mapper.update: update voya_ai_trip_share set status = '1' where trip_id = #{tripId} and status = '0'
mapper.select: select t.id, t.city_id as cityId, c.name as cityName, t.title, t.cover_image as coverImage, t.start_date as startDate, t.end_date as endDate, t.people_count as peopleCount, t.budget, t.travel_type as travelType, t.description, t.source, t.create_time as createTime, t.update_time as updateTime from voya_ai_trip_share s inner join voya_ai_trip t on s.trip_id = t.id left join voya_ai_city c on t.city_id = c.id where s.share_code = #{shareCode} and s.status = '0' and s.expire_time > now() and t.del_flag = '0'
